This '''scavenger''' was a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] who worked for [[Aulus G'luun]]. When [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] security forces barricaded the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], this Gand was captured. Interrogated by a [[Jedi Consular]], the Gand revealed information concerning a network of [[Computer/Legends|computerized]] signals that the Gand and the other [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] used to pass around a [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]] known as the [[Noetikon]]. With this information, the Consular eventually lured Aulus G'luun out of hiding and persuaded him to relinquish the [[Noetikon of Science]], in exchange for allowing him and his fellow Gands to leave the planet.<ref name="TOR-SS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&ndash;"Secret Signals" on Coruscant</ref>
